submission_status: Complete measured report: candidate SHIP; PR remains open for review.
result_interpretation: The candidate improved the overall frozen-check score by 4.1 percentage points (about +3.0 comparison sigma) and diagnosis by 13.1 points (+4.2 sigma), with no decline in the other categories. The targeted diagnostic-restart case improved from 0/10 to 5/5. The answer-token proxy rose from 270.7 to 276.8 (+2.3%), below the 20% limit. No critical safety case failed. This supports the narrow guard fix on this evaluation; other score changes also reflect sampling and grader phrasing sensitivity, not a proven general improvement in causal diagnosis.
failure_analysis: The baseline had 97 failed cases in 410 evaluations: 79 catalog cases, eight payment cases and ten true diagnostic false refusals. The candidate had 40 failures in 205 evaluations: 37 catalog cases and three payment cases. All failed cases missed the cause regex; the baseline false refusals also failed the no-POLICY check. Every one of the 79 baseline catalog failures named disablement before cache/caching on the cause line, whereas the regex expects the opposite word order. These examples expose grading false negatives, so the reported score must not be interpreted as calibrated root-cause accuracy. The evaluator was held fixed throughout this comparison; a future correction requires a new eval version and a remeasured reference baseline.
